title: An evening traffic-noise survey

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Before tonight's traffic-noise survey, collect a sound meter from the council van. Clip it to the stand at your assigned corner. Record the reading at nine, but keep the meter running for the full ten minutes. If a bus idles beside you, write down when it arrived and left instead of deleting the reading. We need to distinguish an unusual event from the background level. After the survey, return the meter to the van, not to the office. If you can't reach your assigned corner because a pavement is closed, call me before choosing another place. If I approve a different corner, write both sites on the sheet before you start, so we can keep their readings separate.
turns.zh: 今晚進行交通噪音調查前，請到市議會的廂型車領取音量計，並將它夾在指定街角的支架上。請在九點記下讀數，但音量計要持續運作滿十分鐘。如果有公車在旁邊怠速，請記下它抵達和離開的時間，不要刪除讀數。我們需要區分特殊事件和背景噪音。調查結束後，請把音量計還到廂型車，不是辦公室。若因人行道封閉而到不了指定的街角，請先打給我，不要自行另選地點。如果我同意換到另一個街角，請在開始量測前把原地點和替代地點都寫在表單上，以便分開處理兩處的讀數。
